revision_summary: Two targeted fixes needed before ship: (1) The 01:44 '$200 per month' quote in cherry_pick_moments[0] and bill_anchor_audit is a merge of the customer's '$200' (01:42) and the rep's 'per month' (01:44) — restate as two separate attributed fragments or cite 01:42 as the anchor ts to avoid implying a single continuous utterance. (2) Reclassify cherry_pick_moments[3], [4], and [5] (03:34, 04:01, 04:47) away from 'objection_inversion_miss' — the schema's objection_inversion mechanism applies to cost/time/interest objections like 'too expensive' or 'not interested,' not to a proposal-before-meeting request where Stage 3 itself concludes the rep correctly held the hard_rule. Relabel as a rebuttal-execution/reassurance-depth gap under rebuttals.send_proposal_before_meeting so the classification doesn't contradict its own stewart_read. Also recommend folding in the 00:45 'What do you need to information?' moment into cherry_pick_moments (paired with 01:52) since it's the first and clearest comprehension-friction signal and currently only lives in starting_state reasoning, and soften the handoff_brief's confident 'language/communication barrier' framing to acknowledge the transcript itself shows possible speaker-misattribution/audio artifacts (e.g., the 01:27 'rep: Yes.' self-answer) that could account for some of the garbled customer lines. Also fix cherry_pick_moments[1]'s schema_reference from curiosity_over_features to bill_anchoring, since the kWh-figure-not-flipped critique is a bill-anchoring gap, not a curiosity/features anti-pattern.
